_readme: Approved changes to the AI prompt files. tests/prompt-guard.test.js undoes these edits and checks the result is byte-for-byte the original prompt (baselineSha256). Any other change to a prompt fails the test. Add an entry here only for a change the owner asked for.

edits.why: Location Note removed from the profile at the owner's request: the AI works out the commute from the Address and the job location.
edits.before: If the role is local to where the candidate lives, reference proximity naturally where it adds genuine value
edits.after: If the role is local to where the candidate lives, reference proximity naturally where it adds genuine value. Work out whether it is local yourself: compare the candidate's Address in the content bank's personal details with the work location in the JD, and estimate the usual travel time from the candidate's suburb to that location from your own knowledge of the area. If it is about 30 minutes or less, you may mention it once in the professional summary, as an approximate figure with the suburb and state only (e.g. "based in Albury, NSW, about 10 minutes from the site"). Never write the street address. Always say "about" or "around", because it is an estimate. If you are unsure of the location or the travel time, the role is fully remote, or the commute is long, leave proximity out, and never invent a willingness to relocate.

edits.why: New Position Description field per role; tells the AI how role descriptions and bullet lines are read so nothing is counted twice. Updated: "Link:" lines belong to the bullet above.
edits.before: - [EXPERIENCE]: for each role, a header line "### <Job Title> | <Dates>", optionally followed by " | [Responsibilities](url)" or " | [Website](url)" as a third field. Next line: the organisation and location, optionally followed by " | [Milestones](url)". If the role absorbed an earlier title, add a line starting "Previously: <earlier title and dates>". Then 3-6 achievement bullets each starting with "- ". Separate roles with one blank line. Reverse chronological. Every bullet starts with a past-tense action verb and quantifies outcomes where possible.
edits.after:
- [EXPERIENCE]: for each role, a header line "### <Job Title> | <Dates>", optionally followed by " | [Responsibilities](url)" or " | [Website](url)" as a third field. Next line: the organisation and location, optionally followed by " | [Milestones](url)". If the role absorbed an earlier title, add a line starting "Previously: <earlier title and dates>". Then 3-6 achievement bullets each starting with "- ". Separate roles with one blank line. Reverse chronological. Every bullet starts with a past-tense action verb and quantifies outcomes where possible.
- In the content bank, a role's "Description:" line is background on the position (its purpose, scope and team). Use it to understand and frame the role, and draw on it only where it adds something the bullets do not. Never add it as an extra bullet or repeat what a bullet already says. Every other line under a role, after its header lines, is one separate responsibility or achievement (except "Link:" lines, which belong to the bullet just above them): count and use each line once.

edits.why: New Promoted tick on roles at the same employer; tells the AI to show the promotion with the existing Previously: line.
edits.before: - [EDUCATION]: for each qualification, a header line "### <Degree> | <Years>", then a line with the institution, optionally followed by " | [Credentials](url)". Reverse chronological.
edits.after:
- A role with a "Promoted from:" line in the content bank was a promotion at the same employer. Show the two as one entry: the later title and its dates in the "###" header line, then the "Previously: <earlier title and dates>" line described above, and do not list the earlier title again as a separate role. Draw the bullets from both roles, using each point once.
- [EDUCATION]: for each qualification, a header line "### <Degree> | <Years>", then a line with the institution, optionally followed by " | [Credentials](url)". Reverse chronological.

edits.why: New per-bullet links in work history: tells the AI to bind each link to its words. Updated: stories can carry links too.

edits.why: New Majors field on education: tells the AI how to show majored subjects.
edits.before: - [EDUCATION]: for each qualification, a header line "### <Degree> | <Years>", then a line with the institution, optionally followed by " | [Credentials](url)". Reverse chronological.
edits.after:
- [EDUCATION]: for each qualification, a header line "### <Degree> | <Years>", then a line with the institution, optionally followed by " | [Credentials](url)". Reverse chronological.
- In the content bank, a qualification's "Majors:" line lists its majored subjects, separated by ";". Name the ones relevant to the JD in brackets after the degree in its header line, e.g. "### Master of Business Administration (Majors: Finance, Strategy) | 2020 - 2022". If none are relevant, leave the majors out.

edits.before: - A specific reason this role or org appeals — mission, location, the work itself, something real
edits.after:
- A specific reason this role or org appeals — mission, location, the work itself, something real
- Location, only if it helps: compare the candidate's Address in the content bank's personal details with the work location in the JD, and estimate the usual travel time from your own knowledge of the area. If it is about 30 minutes or less, you may mention it once, with the suburb only and an approximate figure (e.g. "I live in Albury, about 10 minutes from your office"). Never write the street address. Always say "about" or "around", because it is an estimate. If you are unsure of the location or the travel time, the role is fully remote, or the commute is long, leave it out, and never invent a willingness to relocate.
